ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF DIRECTORIGENERATION
IN PUNJAB STATE POWER CORPORATION LIMITED
Applications are invited for the post of Director/Generation in Punjab State Power
Corporation Limited (PSPCL) at Patiala in HAG Scale of Rs67000-79000
(unrevised) without Grade Pay.
